SELECT X.POPUP_ID, X.POPUP_TITLE, X.POPUP_OPTION, X.ORDER_DATE, X.GUBUN, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AGENT_POPUP_READ D WHERE D.POPUP_ID = X.POPUP_ID AND D.AGENT_CODE = #{st_com_code} -- session com_code AND D.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} -- session user_id ) > 0 THEN '2' ELSE '1' END AS READ_YN FROM ( SELECT POPUP_ID, POPUP_TITLE, POPUP_OPTION, MIN(PO_CREATE_DATE) AS ORDER_DATE, 'BUYER' AS GUBUN FROM ICOMPOHD A, ICOMPODT B, AGENT_POPUP_BOARD C WHERE A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND A.BUYER = C.COM_CODE AND B.ITEM_QTY != B.GR_QTY -- 입고완료가 아닌 주문 건이 있는 경우 AND A.AGENT = #{st_com_code} -- session com_code AND A.PO_CREATE_DATE >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-3),'YYYYMMDD') -- 3개월 전까지 확인 AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN OPEN_DATE AND CLOSE_DATE GROUP BY POPUP_ID, POPUP_TITLE, POPUP_OPTION
UNION ALL
SELECT POPUP_ID, POPUP_TITLE, POPUP_OPTION, OPEN_DATE AS ORDER_DATE, 'ALL' AS GUBUN FROM AGENT_POPUP_BOARD WHERE COM_CODE = 'ALL' AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN OPEN_DATE AND CLOSE_DATE ) X ORDER BY READ_YN, ORDER_DATE DESC
